title: Potentiometer Analog Input Explorer
description: Turn a knob and watch an analog reading sweep smoothly through 1024 values, then see what a digital pin would have made of the same knob.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Chapter 16: Physical Computing and Electrical Safety Basics

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a potentiometer's knob position, the learner demonstrates how turning it produces a proportional analog input reading across a continuous range.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Draggable knob with a continuous readout and an optional digital-input overlay
pedagogical.assessment: Ask what a reading of 700 means in volts and what a digital pin would report.
